title: Parse a connection string
hints: Split the whole text on `";"` first, then handle each segment on its own. Strip it, and skip it if it's empty.
`segment.split("=", 1)` splits at the **first** `=` only, so `"a=b=c"` gives `["a", "b=c"]`. `"=" not in segment` means the segment is malformed.
In the loop: `if "=" not in segment: raise ValueError(f"malformed segment: {segment!r}")`, then `key, value = segment.split("=", 1)` and `config[key.strip().lower()] = value.strip()`.
